name: coreutils-small-14

c_normalization.expected_before:
ok &= copy_internal (src_name, dst_name, dst_dirfd,
                           dst_name + (dst_relname_in - dst_name_in),
                           new_dst, src_sb,
                           ancestors, &non_command_line_options, false,
                           &first_dir_created,
                           &local_copy_into_self, &rename_succeeded);
c_normalization.replacement:
ok = copy_internal (src_name, dst_name, dst_dirfd,
                          dst_name + (dst_relname_in - dst_name_in),
                          new_dst, src_sb,
                          ancestors, &non_command_line_options, false,
                          &first_dir_created,
                          &local_copy_into_self, &rename_succeeded) && ok;
c_normalization.reason: Evaluate every recursive copy eagerly before explicitly accumulating its Boolean result.
Spell copy's Boolean copy-into-self accumulation without compound bitwise assignment.
Spell copy's Boolean first-directory accumulation without compound bitwise assignment.

c_normalization.expected_before:
ok &= copy (arg, dst_name, target_dirfd, dst_relname,
                          new_dst, x, &copy_into_self, NULL);
c_normalization.replacement:
ok = copy (arg, dst_name, target_dirfd, dst_relname,
                         new_dst, x, &copy_into_self, NULL) && ok;
c_normalization.reason: Evaluate every command-line copy eagerly before explicitly accumulating its Boolean result.

c_normalization.expected_before:
ok &= re_protect (dst_name, arg_in_concat, target_dirfd,
                                  dst_relname, attr_list, x);
c_normalization.replacement:
ok = re_protect (dst_name, arg_in_concat, target_dirfd,

c_normalization.reason: Evaluate every parent protection eagerly before explicitly accumulating its Boolean result.
Make cp's inode hash conversions explicit without the scalar compound literal.
Make the standard integer conversion from idx_t to off_t explicit at the checked-add boundary.

selection_policy: The no-security cp closure is translated independently from install and mv because all three compile copy.c, copy-file-data.c, cp-hash.c, force-link.c and selinux.c with applet-specific definitions; C2Rust requires unique source paths within each translation batch.
